description: A performance change nobody measured is a guess. These gates hold the run to numbers taken the same way before and after, and to the distinction between what a lab run reports and what visitors actually experience.

gates.title: Before And After Were Measured The Same Way
gates.rule: Both numbers come from the same tool, the same form factor and the same URL. A lab run compared against a field score, or a phone run against a desktop one, is two different questions with one answer written under them.
gates.fix: scripts/psi.py measure --url <url> --label after, then scripts/psi.py compare.

gates.title: Field Data Was Read, Not Only The Lab Score
gates.rule: The run read what real visitors experience at the 75th percentile. The lab score is a simulation on one throttled connection; the field record is the number that describes the site and the one that ranks it.
gates.fix: scripts/psi.py field --url <url>. Where a URL has too little traffic to have its own record, read the origin's.

gates.title: The Metric That Is Actually Failing Was Named
gates.rule: The run states which metric is out of threshold and worked on that one. Lab scores are dominated by loading, so a site rated poor on responsiveness can be optimised all day without the rating moving.
gates.fix: Read the field record: LCP good under 2.5s, INP good under 200ms, CLS good under 0.1. Work the one that is failing.

gates.title: The Measured URL Is The One People Reach
gates.rule: The measurement was taken against the host and path visitors actually land on. Measuring a host that redirects reports the redirect as part of the page, and measuring only the home page says nothing about the routes carrying the traffic.
gates.fix: Measure the canonical host, and measure the busiest routes as well as the home page.

gates.title: Something Got Faster
gates.rule: The after numbers beat the before numbers on the metric the run set out to fix. A run that measured, changed the project and moved nothing has found that its theory was wrong, and that is a result to record rather than to leave unsaid.
gates.fix: scripts/psi.py compare prints the delta per metric. Where nothing moved, say so and say what the next candidate is.

gates.title: A Budget Was Written Down
gates.rule: The project records the weights and timings it intends to hold, so the next change that breaks them is caught by something other than a person noticing the site feels slow.
gates.fix: scripts/bundle-probe.py budget --write records the current weights as the ceiling.
